title: Filesystem Paths and Directory Operations
learningObjectives: Explain the main rules of filesystem paths and directories.
Identify the key C++ constructs used for filesystem paths and directories.
Apply filesystem paths and directories in a small program.
Recognize common failure cases and safety concerns.
Test a practical scenario and justify the chosen approach.

understand.concept: C++17 <filesystem> provides path and filesystem operations. Compose paths with path / child; inspect entries with exists/is_directory; create nested folders with create_directories. Errors may be handled with error_code or filesystem_error.
understand.whyItMatters: Portable path composition and error checks prevent fragile path strings and filesystem assumptions.
